policy_title: Launch public inquiry into excess deaths and vaccine harms
stated: Reform UK will launch a Public Inquiry into excess deaths and vaccine harms, noting that excess deaths are nearly as high as during the Covid pandemic and young people are over-represented.

source.quote: Excess Deaths and Vaccine Harms Public Inquiry Excess deaths are nearly as high as they were during the Covid pandemic. Young people are over-represented.

bearing_set.reason: The inquiry directly concerns whether a public health medical intervention (vaccines) caused deaths or serious harms, and whether the healthcare system has adequately identified and responded to excess mortality — core questions of healthcare safety, capacity, and accountability.

A formal public inquiry is a due-process and rule-of-law mechanism for citizens who believe they were harmed by state-sanctioned health policy; its conduct and conclusions bear on institutional accountability and the rule of law.

membership_note: Two genuine bearings: O3 because the subject matter is health outcomes and vaccine safety — the inquiry's findings could drive real changes in NHS practice; O9 because a public inquiry is the formal accountability mechanism through which democratic rule-of-law societies investigate potential systemic failures and uphold due process for affected citizens. Effects on social trust (O15) are plausible but too indirect and speculative to clear the non-negligible bar without a more concrete mechanism. Fiscal cost (O12) of a single inquiry is negligible at public-finances scale.
